items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps skin feeling clean without stripping it.
A ceramide moisturizer supports a comfortable skin barrier and helps with the lower moisture score.
A daily mineral SPF 50 protects skin that may still be sensitive and is a good base for any later additions.

response.routine_note: I've held back the glycolic toner for now: since you finished isotretinoin only eight months ago, please ask your dermatologist or prescriber whether your skin is ready for exfoliating acids before adding it. Meanwhile, cleanse and moisturize morning and night, and apply the SPF every morning.
